description: Methods of the Twig\Source and Twig\Markup objects templates can reach (open parts reported by the round-2 fix of P24/P33, recorded in round 3): P38, Twig\Source::getColumn() and __serialize(); P39, the typed property Twig\Markup::__construct() assigns $charset to. Vectors with known_mismatch still differ; the others are controls that must stay identical. Recorded with "isolation": "process".
